name: William Henry Harrison
desc: president of the United States in 1841 (1773–1841)
summary: William Henry Harrison (February 9, 1773 – April 4, 1841) was the ninth president of the United States, serving from March 1841 until his death 31 days later in April. He was the shortest serving president and the first one to die in office. His death triggered a brief constitutional crisis regarding presidential succession which ended when John Tyler, Harrison's vice president, assumed the office.
